Round3: board: Thread A opened DNS_RESOLUTION ledger-svc, impact also inventory-svc, ongoing (round-03/board.md:3). Follow-up OPEN POSTMORTEM_DRAFT (round-03/board.md:4). Round4: board: Thread B opened DB_POOL_EXHAUSTED shipping-svc ongoing (round-04/board.md:3); Follow-up OPEN DATA_BACKFILL (round-04/board.md:4). changes: CHG-131 APPLIED TLS ticket rotation (round-04/changes.md:3). Round5: board: Thread B (DB_POOL shipping) now also notify-worker (round-05/board.md:3); Thread D opened CERT_EXPIRED shipping-svc ongoing (round-05/board.md:4); Follow-up OPEN VENDOR_TICKET (round-05/board.md:5). No changes.md. Logs: shipping-svc tls handshake failed peer=bank-api certificate_expired round-05/logs/shipping-svc.log:1,4,5,7,9,11,17,18 (plus disk lines mixed); notify-worker disk 96% round-05/logs/notify-worker.log:2,5,6,7,10,17,19,21; DNS geo.internal continues inventory/ledger. Still no db pool errors seen -> Thread B likely really DISK_PRESSURE. Next: advance to round 6.

Round6: board: Thread A (DNS ledger/inventory) mitigated (round-06/board.md:3); Follow-up OPEN RUNBOOK_UPDATE (round-06/board.md:4). changes: CHG-142 APPLIED retry budget GETs=1 (round-06/changes.md:3); CHG-150 APPLIED mitigation thread A ledger-svc (round-06/changes.md:4).
